title: catha rufa
intro: Catha rufa, commonly known as Khat, is a flowering plant native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits such as reducing fatigue, improving mental clarity, and aiding in weight loss. The therapeutic actions of Catha rufa include its ability to increase alertness and energy, while its bioactive constituents, including cathinone and cathine, have been shown to have potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. However, excessive consumption of Catha rufa can lead to negative side effects, making it essential to use it in moderation and under professional guidance.
